title: Expected to load a `DatasetDict` object, but provided path is not a `DatasetDict`.`
body:
I download ViRFT_COCO dataset from huggingface, there is only [.parquet] files, no dataset_dict.json. Howevre when I run code,  An Error like this: 
`No such file: '/root/sourcecode/Visual-RFT-main/data/ViRFT_COCO/dataset_dict.json'. Expected to load a `DatasetDict` object, but provided path is not a `DatasetDict`.`
author: Jay-zzcoder

comments.body:
change
```
from datasets import DatasetDict
dataset = DatasetDict.load_from_disk(script_args.dataset_name)
```
to
```
dataset = load_dataset(script_args.dataset_name, name=script_args.dataset_config)
```
in `grpo.py`
